findings: No candidate finding: Playground reaches only academy-review among workspace crates, is absent from default members, contains no eager data-URI path, and all workspace behavior remains green.

residual_uncertainty: The native macOS smoke establishes startup and process stability, but automated verification does not visually assert poster rendering, playback, download behavior, or seeking in every platform webview.
The existing transitive block v0.1.6 dependency emits Cargo's future-incompatibility warning; this candidate neither introduces nor removes it.
